title: Review repeated unresolved patterns
preconditions: The evaluation and its active rule set are retained and compatible; the caller supplies bounded top-N and minimum-count values; a fresh complete Ledger classification_v1 evaluation projection can be acquired.
postconditions: Every no_suggestion row is accounted for; report and group fingerprints detect semantic drift; no raw description or report row is persisted by CLASSIFY; the result proposes owner-review candidates only and creates or activates no rule.
main_flow: The caller invokes classify.unresolved.report; CLASSIFY joins retained no_suggestion outcomes to the fresh projection, verifies all lifecycle and fingerprint dimensions, groups production-normalized descriptions by account and direction, computes counts and checked aggregate signed amounts, orders candidates deterministically, and returns only the bounded owner-local report.
alt_flows: Reject expired evaluation, stale Ledger generation, changed active rule set, archived category lifecycle, missing or duplicate projection rows, or incompatible projection with a typed no-result failure.
Reject over-limit rows, groups, top-N, normalization, checked amount sum, runtime, or memory before returning a partial report.
Never write descriptions to logs, durable CLASSIFY state, cursors, generated docs, or tracked files.
